report:
Freshly reviewed meta.reviews.preparation after the association and interrupted-publication coverage changes. Both ordinary implementation associations (review.rs::start and main.rs::review) and all seven ordinary associated tests were inspected. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred claim aspects remain. Compared fresh captured implementation text to the earlier capture: review.rs is unchanged; main.rs adds the essential CLI associations without behavior changes. Captured full tests/review.rs supplies fixture helpers; captured reviews.md supplies governing context.
Implementation: start checks valid anchor syntax, obtains validated current inventory and resolves the requested anchor before any clearing. It attaches coordinator instructions, locks the validation parent, removes only the selected directory, then recreates it and writes fresh input and unrecorded summary before returning. The CLI serializes and prints the returned input only after successful start. inventory includes complete claim, implementation files, complete annotated tests, prompt and association metadata. Unknown/invalid IDs fail before mutation. Removal precedes all new publication, so a failed subsequent write cannot leave an old output validating fresh inputs; load_saved and validate reject absent or incomplete records. Other anchor directories are unaffected.
Tests collectively substantiate every part. cli_start_and_record_roundtrip_exact_saved_input verifies exact printed/persisted input and coordinator instruction text. initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments verifies exact prompt, instructions, claim, implementation source, complete test text and persisted input. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection verifies implementation/test metadata, conditions, statuses and the uniform collection while preserving initial content. start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required begins from a passing unchanged-source approval and checks new summary, absent output, failing shared library gate, no fallback after reads, and recovery only after record. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports checks malformed/traversal/absolute/unknown anchor rejection and unchanged old output; additional-read assertions concern its other associated claims. restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged checks all three sibling files byte-for-byte and failure until the selected anchor is recorded. interrupted_start_publication_states_cannot_reuse_an_old_approval starts from an approval and checks BOTH library and CLI failure for missing directory, empty recreated directory, fresh input without summary, and successful unrecorded restart; output is absent and recording restores success. These explicit interrupted states, actual start clearing assertions, and inspected ordered publication account for failure safety without requiring production fault injection. All prior requested edits are resolved.
Refresh assessment: Fresh start captured all current initial fragments, and review read recaptured the full test file and review specification. Exact comparison against my earlier inspected capture shows the preparation claim, review.rs implementation, both implementation metadata entries, complete seven-test association set, and verification prompt unchanged. main.rs adds only the review_diagnostics association to check. The associated start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required gains recorded_reads/recording annotations; its body is unchanged. Therefore the trace and adequacy analysis above remain supported by current source. The full test-file dependency has additional diagnostic assertions, associations and two new read/record tests; inspected those deltas, confirmed fixture helpers unchanged and no removal or weakening of preparation assertions. These unrelated additions do not change the preparation guarantee. The newly captured reviews.md is identical to the earlier specification context. All requirements remain covered and no edits are requested.
Execution distinction for this refresh: personally executed review start with /tmp/sage-refresh-10.txt, review read for both relied-on dependencies, exact source comparisons and review record. No source edits, build or behavioral test suite executed during refresh. Earlier cargo fmt --check was executed by this reviewer in the prior review turn. Coordinator now reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passing; those are separately reported results and are not claimed as my executions. Approval is based on reassessed source and assertions, not merely passing commands.
